stories.title: Zuppi sulla scuola: "Tocca il cuore della nostra convivenza. Sia inclusiva e non ridotta al metodo"

en.title: Zuppi on school: "It touches the heart of our coexistence. It should be inclusive and not reduced to method"
en.summary: The president of Italian bishops states that education means helping a person become free and capable of seeking truth and recognizing good. He emphasizes that school should be inclusive rather than methodologically restricted.

stories.title: Testate escluse da Trump dalla Casa Bianca: CNN, Politico e MsNow fanno causa al governo

en.title: News outlets excluded by Trump from the White House: CNN, Politico and MsNow sue the government
en.summary: CNN, Politico and MsNow filed lawsuits based on the First Amendment to challenge their exclusion from White House access, asserting the government should not control press reporting. Trump responded by claiming action against fake news, while the broadcaster pool ceased following the president.

stories.title: Chi è la candidata della Linke a Berlino Elif Eralp, già ribattezzata la "Mamdani" tedesca

en.title: Who is Die Linke's candidate in Berlin Elif Eralp, already nicknamed the German "Mamdani"
en.summary: The 45-year-old migrant rights lawyer and daughter of Turkish union activists campaigns on issues affecting younger voters, particularly the housing affordability crisis in Berlin, drawing comparisons to New York's mayor approach.

en.title: Zuppi, 'school must be inclusive'
en.summary: The bishop states that birthplace should not determine educational opportunities for students.

stories.title: Tetto agli stranieri in classe, Zuppi: “La scuola sia inclusiva, la nascita non decida il futuro”

en.title: Ceiling on foreign students in class, Zuppi: "School should be inclusive, birth should not decide the future"
en.summary: The head of the Italian bishops' conference opposes limits on foreign students in classrooms, emphasizing inclusive education. He highlighted educational inequalities, with nearly 10% of young people dropping out early and many schools inaccessible to students with disabilities.

stories.title: Tetto agli stranieri nelle classi, cosa prevede il decreto annunciato e quali sono le criticità

en.title: Ceiling on foreign students in classes, what the announced decree provides and what the critical issues are
en.summary: A decree proposes free Italian language lessons for parents of foreign students, though concerns exist about potential displacement of children to other areas with lower concentrations of foreign residents.

stories.title: Cnn, MsNow e Politico fanno causa a Trump per il divieto di accesso alla Casa Bianca. E le altre tv annunciano il boicottaggio

en.title: CNN, MSNow and Politico sue Trump for ban from White House. Other networks announce boycott
en.summary: Three news outlets filed lawsuits against Trump citing First Amendment protections for press freedom after being denied White House access. Additional networks said they would stop covering his activities in solidarity.

stories.title: Cnn, MsNow e Politico fanno causa a Trump: accesso negato alla Casa Bianca. Stop copertura attività

en.title: CNN, MSNow and Politico sue Trump: White House access denied. Coverage stops
en.summary: Three news organizations sued over First Amendment violations following their White House ban. ABC, CBS, Fox News and NBC joined by ceasing coverage of Trump's official activities and events.

stories.title: Violenta un 12enne al parco dell’Arrivore: prima di scappare gli offre patatine e Coca-Cola

en.title: 12-year-old violently assaulted in Arrivore park; attacker offers snacks before fleeing
en.summary: A child was lured to a park in Turin and assaulted by an attacker who offered snacks before escaping. The victim was found in shock and reported the incident to his mother, prompting a police investigation.

stories.title: Daniel Maldini, negativo test tossicologico del Niguarda: livelli di stupefacenti sotto la soglia

en.title: Daniel Maldini, Niguarda toxicology test negative: drug levels below threshold
en.summary: A toxicology test revealed drug levels below the legal threshold following a Milan car crash, though a drink-driving charge and licence suspension remain in effect.

stories.title: Torino, violenta un 12enne al parco: prima di scappare offre una merenda al minimarket

en.title: Turin: 12-year-old assaulted in park; attacker offers snacks before fleeing
en.summary: An adult male on a scooter approached a child at his home and took him to Arrivore park where an assault occurred. The attacker subsequently offered the victim snacks before leaving the scene.

stories.title: Il Sanremo di De Martino prende forma, c’è il regolamento: 24 in gara e la “Serata Performance”

en.title: De Martino's Sanremo takes shape with regulations: 24 contestants and "Performance Night"
en.summary: The Sanremo festival will run February 16-20 with 24 competing artists and newly introduced AI usage restrictions. Online voting is permitted, and contestant announcements are expected on November 29.

stories.title: Riciclo tessile, Igers inaugura impianto da 8 milioni di euro

en.title: Textile recycling: Igers inaugurates 8 million euro facility
en.summary: Igers, a Milan-based company, opened a textile waste recycling plant in Novara with an annual capacity of 19,000 tonnes. The facility represents an 8 million euro investment.

stories.title: Sanremo chiude la porta all’AI: «Canzoni espressione della creatività umana»

en.title: Sanremo closes door to AI: "Songs expression of human creativity"
en.summary: The Sanremo Festival has established new regulations for its 2027 edition that exclude artificial intelligence from competing songs, affirming that musical entries must be expressions of human creativity.

stories.title: Nexture si rafforza in Medio Oriente con l’acquisizione di La Crema

en.title: Nexture strengthens in Middle East with acquisition of La Crema
en.summary: Nexture, a food ingredients and added-value solutions company controlled by Investindustrial, has agreed to acquire La Crema in a move to expand its presence in the Middle Eastern market.

stories.title: Mutui, l’impatto dei tassi: rincaro medio fino a 540 euro all’anno sui nuovi contratti

en.title: Mortgages, the impact of rates: average increase up to 540 euros per year on new contracts
en.summary: New mortgage contracts in October for 130,000 euros face estimated additional costs of approximately 540 euros annually, totaling around 13,500 euros over 25 years due to current interest rate levels.

stories.title: Dal coworking alle case: Wao scommette sugli affitti flessibili

en.title: From coworking to homes: Wao bets on flexible rentals
en.summary: Wao, a company offering flexible rental options ranging from one night to one year for apartments, is expanding its business model beyond coworking spaces.
